critical_code_review_comments: Vendors.jsx used a non-existent endpoint /centers for populating the center picker. This would have shipped a completely non-functional 'Assigned Centers' picker for every role. Recommend a lint/grep guard that flags api.get("/centers") since the real endpoint is /entities/center everywhere else.
Backend logic for _vendor_scope_editable and PUT filter (preserve out-of-scope, require at least one own center) is well-tested and behaves correctly.

VendorIn.center_ids default via Field(default_factory=list) → good; PUT body always overwrites center_ids from client, but CM path safely re-merges with existing out-of-scope. HQ PUT with model_dump() will overwrite center_ids on every edit (HQ must always resend the full list) — acceptable but consider using exclude_unset for partial updates in a future iteration.

rca of the issue: Bug: Vendors.jsx line 50 called api.get('/centers') → 404. Cause: developer used a shorter path that doesn't exist in server.py; every other page uses api.get('/entities/center'). Impact: 'Assigned Centers' checklist rendered empty for ALL users; CM validation blocked creation UNLESS backend auto-filled center_ids from CM's assigned_center_ids (the backend safety net masked the failure for CM creates but not for HQ picking specific centers). Fix applied: changed to '/entities/center'. Re-verified: 2 checkboxes rendered pre-checked, all UI acceptance criteria pass.
